items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: No, I never did. No, I didn't play with Tatum ever. ... I really idolized him

ctx.x: Did you play with Tatum ever?

No, I never did. No, I didn't play with Tatum ever. I don't know if any drummers have played with Tatum, really. Because Tatum appeared -- I went over to see him at the Paramount Theatre, and I think Rube Wolfe was there, but I really idolized him; he used to go to a lot of track meets with Tatum.
You know, Tatum could see. He could see.
